# #383 — DISTILL-2: Stand up a local MLX generation endpoint sized for core01

## Problem

Distillation needs a generation endpoint. The local MLX server on
`127.0.0.1:8791` serves **embeddings only** (`embeddinggemma-300m-8bit`);
there is no generation route anywhere.

Distillation runs on every session's raw content, continuously, forever.
Routing that through a hosted model sends the entire memory stream off-box,
costs per-token indefinitely, and makes the brain unable to think offline —
defeating the purpose of the local dogfood.

## Measured constraints (2026-07-24)

core01 (`rtech-mini-m4-core01`, the production target):

- Apple M4, 10 cores, **16 GB**
- total RSS 12.1 GB; ~225 MB genuinely free; ~1.8 GB wired
- no single hog — many small daemons plus OB's bun workers and the 300 MB
  embedding server
- **usable generation budget: ~3 GB**

The dogfood box is an M4 Pro / 24 GB on macOS 27, so it is **not**
representative. Size for core01 and run it locally under the same constraint,
or the test proves nothing.

## Model selection

Verified against the HF API rather than blog claims:

| Model | Size on disk | Fits ~3 GB |
|---|---|---|
| `mlx-community/Qwen3.5-4B-4bit` | 3.06 GB | yes |
| `mlx-community/gemma-4-e2b-it-4bit` | 3.58 GB | marginal |
| `mlx-community/gemma-4-e4b-it-4bit` | 5.18 GB | no |

Blog-sourced sizes for Gemma 4 E4B (~3 GB) were wrong; it is 5.18 GB.

Start with **Qwen3.5-4B-4bit**. No pruned/extraction-specialized small model
exists in MLX format — searched; the closest are task-specific encoders and
NVIDIA Minitron base models. Do not optimize the model before measuring what
it gets wrong.

## Scope

- Generation server at
  `/Volumes/ThunderBolt/open-brain-local/mlx-generation-server/`, weights
  under `open-brain-local/models/`. Loopback only, OpenAI-compatible,
  mirroring the embedding-server pattern. Nothing on the main disk, nothing in
  the repo.
- Load-on-demand rather than resident: spawn, drain the queue, exit. Idle cost
  zero; ~5 s startup is irrelevant for background work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Endpoint answers an OpenAI-compatible completion on loopback.
- [ ] Resident set stays within the core01 budget while OB serves normally.
- [ ] Benchmarked on real captured events, with tok/s and output validity
      recorded.

## Later

Once real input/output pairs exist, DWQ (`mlx_lm.dwq`) or a LoRA on the actual
distillation schema will beat generic pruning — but only after measurement.
